# Agent Tool Adapters

Experimental, dependency-free Python reference library for explicit tool adapter registration and policy-gated invocation.

- README.md: scope, quick start, and limitations.
- docs/ADAPTER-CONTRACT.md: invocation sequence and adapter contract.
- docs/THREAT-MODEL.md: trust boundaries and non-goals.
- schemas/tool-adapter-descriptor.schema.json: machine-readable adapter descriptor.
- Python API: agent_tool_adapters.
- No third-party adapters, sandbox, authentication, network transport, or production policy integration are included.
